Roman-numeral section markers, and tiny editorial annotations.

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-colorful

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-creative

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-default

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-editorial

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-elegant

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-energetic

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-enterprise

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-expressive

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-fantasy

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-futuristic

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-glassmorphism

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-gradient

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-luxury

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-material

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-minimal

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-mission-control

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-modern

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-mono

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-neobrutalism

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-neon

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-neumorphism

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-paper

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-perspective

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-premium

plugins.description: Apple-inspired premium aesthetic with precise spacing, modern typography, and a refined, polished visual language.

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-professional

plugins.description: Polished, business-ready design with modern typography, structured layouts, and a trustworthy visual identity.

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-publication

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-refined
plugins.title: Refined
plugins.description: Carefully curated, modern minimal style with elegant serif typography and understated, sophisticated palettes.

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-retro

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-shadcn

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-simple
plugins.title: Simple

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-skeumorphism
plugins.title: Skeumorphism
plugins.description: Real-world mimicry with textured surfaces, 3D effects, and familiar physical metaphors for intuitive digital interfaces.

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-sleek
plugins.title: Sleek

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-spacious
plugins.title: Spacious
plugins.description: Generous whitespace, consistent padding, and grid-based layouts for clean, readable, and breathing interfaces.

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-storytelling
plugins.title: Storytelling
plugins.description: Narrative-driven design using visuals, copy, and interaction to guide users through engaging, emotionally resonant journeys.

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-urdu
plugins.title: Urdu Modern (Indus Script System)
plugins.description: Urdu-first digital experiences with native RTL support,Nastaliq typography, and bilingual harmony.

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-vibrant
plugins.title: Vibrant
plugins.description: Lively, colorful design with bold playful typography, warm accents, and dynamic visual energy.

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-vintage
plugins.title: Vintage
plugins.description: 1950s-1990s nostalgia with skeuomorphic touches, grainy textures, retro color palettes, and pixel-style typography.

plugins.name: open-design/design-system-warm-editorial
plugins.title: Warm Editorial
plugins.description:
A serif-led magazine aesthetic. Terracotta accent on warm off-white paper —
good for long-form, editorial, and brand-led marketing pages.

plugins.name: open-design/diff-review
plugins.title: Diff review
plugins.description: Surface the accumulated patch as a reviewable diff and persist the accept / reject decision.

plugins.name: open-design/direction-picker
plugins.title: Direction picker
plugins.description: Optional 3-5 direction picker for users who explicitly ask to compare visual directions.

plugins.name: open-design/discovery-question-form
plugins.title: Discovery question form
plugins.description: Structured clarification form for unresolved material requirements.

plugins.name: open-design/example-article-magazine
plugins.title: Magazine Article
plugins.description: Huashu / huashu-md-html-inspired magazine article layout for turning Markdown or notes into a polished long-form HTML essay.

description_i18n.en: Huashu / huashu-md-html-inspired magazine article layout for turning Markdown or notes into a polished long-form HTML essay.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Huashu / huashu-md-html 风格杂志文章版式, 将 Markdown 或笔记转成精排长文 HTML。

plugins.name: open-design/example-audio-jingle
plugins.title: Audio Jingle
plugins.description:
Audio generation skill — jingles, beds, voiceover, and sound effects.
Routes music requests to Suno V5 / Udio / Lyria, speech to MiniMax
TTS / FishAudio / ElevenLabs V3, and SFX to ElevenLabs SFX or
AudioCraft. Output is one MP3/WAV file saved to the project folder.

plugins.name: open-design/example-blog-post
plugins.title: Blog Post
plugins.description:
A long-form article / blog post — masthead, hero image placeholder,
article body with figures and pull quotes, author byline, related posts.
Use when the brief asks for "blog", "article", "post", "essay", or
"case study".

plugins.name: open-design/example-card-twitter
plugins.title: Twitter Share Card
plugins.description: Twitter quote or data card designed to pair with a post.

description_i18n.en: Twitter quote or data card designed to pair with a post.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 推特金句 / 数据卡, 适合配推文

plugins.name: open-design/example-clinical-case-report
plugins.title: Clinical Case Report
plugins.description:
Structured medical case presentation for clinical rounds, conferences,
and documentation. Generates SOAP-format or narrative case reports
with physiologically accurate vitals, labs, and evidence-based plans.
Use when the brief mentions "case report", "case presentation", "SOAP note",
"clinical case", "ward rounds", "case summary", or "patient presentation".

plugins.name: open-design/example-critique
plugins.title: Critique
plugins.description:
Run a 5-dimension expert design review on any HTML artifact in the
project — Philosophy / Visual hierarchy / Detail / Functionality /
Innovation, each scored 0–10. Outputs a single self-contained HTML
report with a radar chart, evidence-backed scores, and three lists:
Keep / Fix / Quick-wins. Use when the brief asks for a "design
review", "design critique", "5 维度评审", "design audit", or "what's
wrong with my design".

plugins.name: open-design/example-dashboard
plugins.title: Dashboard
plugins.description:
Admin / analytics dashboard in a single HTML file. Fixed left sidebar,
top bar with user/search, main grid of KPI cards and one or two charts.
Use when the brief asks for a "dashboard", "admin", "analytics", or
"control panel" screen.

plugins.name: open-design/example-data-report
plugins.title: Data Visualization Report
plugins.description: Turns CSV, Excel, or JSON data into a polished visual report page.

description_i18n.en: Turns CSV, Excel, or JSON data into a polished visual report page.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 CSV/Excel/JSON 数据转成漂亮的可视化报告页

plugins.name: open-design/example-dcf-valuation
plugins.title: Dcf Valuation
plugins.description:
Discounted cash flow valuation and intrinsic value analysis for public
companies. Use when the brief asks for DCF, fair value, intrinsic value,
price target, undervalued or overvalued analysis, or "what is this company
worth?"

plugins.name: open-design/example-deck-open-slide-canvas
plugins.title: Open-Slide 1920 Canvas Deck
plugins.description: Locked 1920x1080 canvas deck with React component-level free composition, not bound to a fixed template.

description_i18n.en: Locked 1920x1080 canvas deck with React component-level free composition, not bound to a fixed template.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 锁死 1920×1080 画布, React 组件级自由组合, 不绑模板

plugins.name: open-design/example-deck-swiss-international
plugins.title: Swiss International Deck
plugins.description: 16-column grid, one saturated accent, and 22 locked layouts (Klein Blue, Lemon, Mint, Safety Orange).

description_i18n.en: 16-column grid, one saturated accent, and 22 locked layouts (Klein Blue, Lemon, Mint, Safety Orange).

plugins.name: open-design/example-design-brief
plugins.title: Design Brief
plugins.description:
Parse a structured design brief written in I-Lang protocol format into a
concrete design spec. Eliminates ambiguity from vague requests like
"make it professional" by requiring explicit dimensions: palette, typography,
layout, mood, density, and constraints.
Trigger keywords: "design brief", "create a design brief", "ilang brief", "structured brief".

plugins.name: open-design/example-digital-eguide
plugins.title: Digital Eguide
plugins.description:
A two-spread digital e-guide preview — page 1 is a cover (display title,
author, "What's inside" stats, table of contents teaser); page 2 is a
spread (lesson body with pull-quote and a step list). Lifestyle / creator
brand tone. Use when the brief asks for an "e-guide", "digital guide",
"lookbook", "lead magnet", "creator guide", "playbook", "PDF guide",
or "电子指南".

plugins.name: open-design/example-docs-page
plugins.title: Docs Page
plugins.description:
A documentation page — inline-start nav, scrollable article body,
inline-end table of contents. Use when the brief mentions "docs",
"documentation", "guide", "API reference", or "tutorial".

plugins.name: open-design/example-email-marketing
plugins.title: Email Marketing
plugins.description:
A brand product-launch email — masthead with wordmark, hero image block,
headline lockup with skewed-italic accent, body copy, primary CTA, and a
specifications grid. Pure HTML email layout (centered single column, table
fallback). Use when the brief asks for an "email", "newsletter blast",
"MJML", "product launch email", or "email template".

plugins.name: open-design/example-eng-runbook
plugins.title: Eng Runbook
plugins.description:
An engineering runbook — service overview, alerts table, dashboards
links, common procedures with copy-pasteable commands, on-call rotation,
and an incident-response checklist. Use when the brief mentions
"runbook", "ops doc", "on-call guide", "SRE doc", or "运维手册".

plugins.name: open-design/example-finance-report
plugins.title: Finance Report
plugins.description:
Quarterly / monthly financial report — masthead with KPIs, revenue and
burn charts, P&L summary table, top-line highlights, and an outlook
paragraph. Use when the brief mentions "financial report", "Q3 report",
"MRR review", "P&L", or "财报".

plugins.name: open-design/example-flowai-live-dashboard-template
plugins.title: Flowai Live Dashboard Template
plugins.description:
Team-management dashboard skill in the FlowAI aesthetic — three tabs
(Team Members, Team Details, Activity Log), KPI stat row, member table,
role distribution bar chart, online presence and activity sparklines,
and a top-contributors panel, all in a single self-contained HTML file
with light/dark theming, hoverable chart tooltips, click-to-zoom panels,
and CSV export. Use when the brief asks for a team / workspace admin
dashboard, an interactive admin dashboard with charts, or names FlowAI.

plugins.description: NYT-newsroom typography, staggered reveal animation, and editorial-grade charts (line, bar, or range band).

plugins.description: Film light leaks, grain, 16:9 letterbox, and large serif type for cinematic openings or chapter cards.

plugins.title: Liquid Background Hero
plugins.description: WebGL-style fluid displacement background with a quote overlay, suited to video intros, landing heroes, or posters.

plugins.title: Logo Outro Frame
plugins.description: Segmented logo assembly, glow bloom, and tagline reveal for video outros or brand closing frames.

description_i18n.en: Segmented logo assembly, glow bloom, and tagline reveal for video outros or brand closing frames.

plugins.name: open-design/example-frame-macos-notification
plugins.title: macOS Notification Banner
plugins.description: Realistic macOS notification banner with app icon, title, and body, suited to video overlays or product teasers.

description_i18n.en: Realistic macOS notification banner with app icon, title, and body, suited to video overlays or product teasers.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 拟真 macOS 通知 banner + app icon + 标题正文, 适合 video overlay / 产品发布预告

plugins.name: open-design/example-gamified-app
plugins.title: Gamified App
plugins.description:
A multi-frame gamified mobile-app prototype — three phone frames on a dark
showcase stage. Frame 1: cover / poster, Frame 2: today's quests with XP
ribbons and a level bar, Frame 3: quest detail. Vivid quest tiles, level
ribbon, bottom tab bar. Use when the brief asks for a "gamified app",
"habit tracker", "RPG-style life app", "level-up app", "daily quests",
"XP / streak app", or "ELI5-style explainer app".

plugins.name: open-design/example-github-dashboard
plugins.title: Github Dashboard
plugins.description:
GitHub repository analytics dashboard — stars, forks, contributors,
issues, pull requests, recent activity, and top contributors. Use when
the brief asks for a GitHub repo dashboard, open-source growth report,
repository health page, or GitHub analytics view.

plugins.name: open-design/example-hr-onboarding
plugins.title: Hr Onboarding
plugins.description:
A new-hire onboarding plan as a single page — first week schedule,
buddy + manager intro, learning track, equipment checklist, and "you're
set when…" outcomes. Use when the brief mentions "onboarding",
"new hire", "first week plan", or "入职".

plugins.name: open-design/example-html-ppt
plugins.title: Html Ppt
plugins.description: HTML PPT Studio — author professional static HTML presentations in many styles, layouts, and animations, all driven by templates. Use when the user asks for a presentation, PPT, slides, keynote, deck, slideshow, "幻灯片", "演讲稿", "做一份 PPT", "做一份 slides", a reveal-style HTML deck, a 小红书 图文, or any kind of multi-slide pitch/report/sharing document that should look tasteful and be usable with keyboard navigation. Triggers include keywords like "presentation", "ppt", "slides", "deck", "keynote", "reveal", "slideshow", "幻灯片", "演讲稿", "分享稿", "小红书图文", "talk slides", "pitch deck", "tech sharing", "technical presentation".

plugins.name: open-design/example-html-ppt-course-module
plugins.title: Html Ppt Course Module
plugins.description: Online-course / workshop module deck — warm paper background + Playfair serif, persistent left sidebar of learning objectives, MCQ self-check page. Use for teaching modules, training materials, workshop slides.

plugins.name: open-design/example-html-ppt-graphify-dark-graph
plugins.title: Html Ppt Graphify Dark Graph
plugins.description: 暗底知识图谱 deck — #06060c→#0e1020 深夜渐变 + 漂浮 blur orbs、封面 SVG 力导向图谱、彩虹渐变标题、JetBrains Mono 命令行高亮、glass-morphism 卡片。适合 dev-tool / CLI / 知识图谱 / 数据可视化的发布会，"AI-native + 科幻 + 暖色" 调子。

plugins.name: open-design/example-html-ppt-hermes-cyber-terminal
plugins.title: Html Ppt Hermes Cyber Terminal
plugins.description: 暗终端 honest-review deck — #0a0c10 黑底 + 56px 赛博网格 + CRT 暗角 + 扫描线、窗口红绿灯 chrome、`$ prompt` 命令行标题、薄荷绿 #7ed3a4 大字、JetBrains Mono、stroke-only 柱状图、blinking 光标、琥珀/绿/红三档 tag、暗色代码块。适合 CLI / agent / dev tool 测评（含 trace、diff、benchmark）。

plugins.name: open-design/example-html-ppt-knowledge-arch-blueprint
plugins.title: Html Ppt Knowledge Arch Blueprint
plugins.description: 奶油蓝图架构 deck — 奶油纸 #F0EAE0 底色 + 单一锈红 #B5392A 高亮、48px 蓝图网格 mask、2px 黑边硬卡片、pipeline 步骤盒（其中一个抬高）、右侧锈红 insight callout、Playfair 衬线大字、SVG 虚线反馈环。零渐变零软阴影，认真且印刷友好。

plugins.name: open-design/example-html-ppt-obsidian-claude-gradient

plugins.name: open-design/example-orbit-general
plugins.title: Orbit General
plugins.description:
Open Orbit briefing skill — selected by the Orbit pipeline when the
user has two or more connectors connected. Pulls the past 24 hours of
activity from every authenticated connector (GitHub, Linear, Notion,
Slack, 飞书, Calendar, Gmail, Drive, Sentry, Vercel, …) and renders a
single adaptive bento-grid dashboard at the top of "我的设计". Each
connector module picks its own UI form (list, avatar stack, status
ring, heatmap, file grid, alert card, …) based on the data shape it
returns, so the layout scales as Orbit's connector ecosystem grows.
This skill should not be triggered manually — it is invoked by
Orbit's daily-digest scheduler against the user's live connector
data.

plugins.name: open-design/example-orbit-github
plugins.title: Orbit Github
plugins.description:
Open Orbit briefing skill — selected by the Orbit pipeline when
GitHub is the user's only connected connector, or when the user
explicitly scopes their daily digest to GitHub. Pulls the past 24
hours of PRs, review requests, issues, CI runs, and merges from the
user's authenticated GitHub connection and renders them in a layout
that mirrors GitHub's native Notifications + PR-diff visual language.
This skill should not be triggered manually — it is invoked by
Orbit's daily-digest scheduler against live GitHub data.

plugins.name: open-design/example-orbit-gmail
plugins.title: Orbit Gmail
plugins.description:
Open Orbit briefing skill — selected by the Orbit pipeline when
Gmail is the user's only connected connector, or when the user
explicitly scopes their daily digest to Gmail. Pulls the past 24
hours of inbox activity (replies awaited, mentions, cc, auto-
categorized bulk) from the user's authenticated Gmail connection
and renders the digest as the Orbit Daily Digest email opened
inside Gmail's reading view. This skill should not be triggered
manually — it is invoked by Orbit's daily-digest scheduler against
live Gmail data.

plugins.name: open-design/example-orbit-linear
plugins.title: Orbit Linear
plugins.description:
Open Orbit briefing skill — selected by the Orbit pipeline when

hours of issue movement, status changes, assignments, and cycle
progress from the user's authenticated Linear connection and renders
the digest in Linear's native Inbox + cycle-progress visual language.
This skill should not be triggered manually — it is invoked by
Orbit's daily-digest scheduler against live Linear data.

plugins.name: open-design/example-orbit-notion
